comment: Using realisation to express country-to-reference mapping implies that the national element fully implements the intent of the reference element. This may be too strong for partial, broader, narrower, or approximate mappings.

public.text: Using realisation to express country-to-reference mapping implies that the national element fully implements the intent of the reference element. This may be too strong for partial, broader, narrower, or approximate mappings.
public.suggestedRevision: Use realisation only for full fulfilment. Define separate mapping relationships or properties for exact, partial, broader, narrower, alternative, and related correspondences.
